record_type_quote: This study set out to replicate a survey conducted 20 years ago on Finnish parents’ social representations of educability.

targets.title: Social representations of educability.
targets.evidence_quote: Our previous survey examined how Finnish parents recei ved the major 1990s change in educational policy, which highlighted the role of competition, choice, standards, and market principles (Räty and Snellman 1998;c f.Brown 1990).
targets.outcome_quote: The representational field of educability seemed quite established, indicating relative continuity of educational discourse.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract frames the repeated survey as showing continuity of the original representational field. The author-uploaded introduction states the original two representations; complete full-text acquisition was unavailable, limiting confidence.

reasoning: New nationwide parental sample repeats the earlier published survey. The author-uploaded introduction explicitly cites Räty and Snellman (1998) as that survey, distinguishing it from the 1996 paper in the references. Only publisher abstract and reference preview were saved; no complete full-text file was acquired.
acquisition_notes: Publisher subscription preview; OpenAlex and Unpaywall offer no OA location. ResearchGate author full text was visible through web indexing, but direct page and PDF requests returned 403. No signed-in browser used.
